How to Play Paper Fan Chop!{KP}It's a Japanese-style "Wild West duel" game!{KP}Count to 5, and when the "Duel" mark appears, press the Circle button!{KP}Smack your opponent first to score points!{KP}Smack before the "Duel" mark appears and you won't score!{KP}If your opponent smacks you first, you get no points either!{KP}Your level is decided by your total over 3 rounds!{KP}Feel like a quick-draw gunslinger and aim for 0 seconds!

Paper Fan Chop! Here's how the versus game works!{KP}It's 3 rounds, and whoever scores higher wins!{KP}Count to 5, and when the "Duel" mark appears, press the Circle button!{KP}Smack before "Duel" and your whole current score turns negative!{KP}The points you lose go to your opponent!{KP}Try your best to smack faster than your opponent!{KP}1P is Momotaro-san, and 2P is Kintaro-san!
